stem: A marker explains 12% of trait variance in one population. Which use is most defensible?
choices: Use it as one piece of selection information while validating predictive value in the target breeding population
Treat it as a complete replacement for phenotyping
Assume it explains 100% in related crosses
Use it without recording population context
rationale: A partial-effect marker can support selection, but its utility depends on validation and integration with other evidence.
